read.thesis: Morgan Stanley's Q3 2026 showed record wealth NNA of $232.4B and equities revenue up 41% to $5.8B, but no supply-side signal; capex and capacity were not discussed and the tone was cautious on rates and geopolitics.

triggers.label: Wealth NNA record $232.4B
triggers.quote: net new assets, of $232 billion and fee-based flows of $80 billion

triggers.label: NII modest increase expected Q4
triggers.quote: Looking ahead, we expect a modest increase in the fourth quarter. Subject to rates and client behavior.

triggers.label: Equities revenue +41% YoY
triggers.quote: Turning to equity. Revenues were $5.8 billion increasing 41% versus the prior year.

guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we expect a modest increase in the fourth quarter. Subject to rates and client behavior.

guidance.value: unchanged; Q4 tax rate slightly above Q3's 23.3%
guidance.quote: For the fourth quarter, we expect our tax rate to be slightly above the third quarter's tax rate, and our full year guidance remains unchanged.

red_flags.label: Management flags geopolitical, rate and policy risks into 2027
red_flags.quote: uncertain electoral and policy responses in both The US and globally are reasons to be more cautious

evasions.quote: it is a little frustrating. There are some sponsors in the universe that are stuck on marks.
